name: flightdeck-conductor
description: Govern AI agent work from Claude: read and create task packets on a local FlightDeck board, dispatch and receive handoffs, run operator-defined verification, and STOP a lane with a chained, tamper-evident HOLD record.
long_description: FlightDeck turns your AI coding agents into governed work. Dispatch, HOLD, reassignment and provisioning land on a hash-chained, tamper-evident event ledger; signals and verification results are recorded on the packet beside it. Claims an agent asserts are gated through adjudication before they can become work; scope is observed from git rather than trusted from the agent's self-report; liveness says whether anything is actually running and for how long; burn and budget read what the board actually cost. Local-first: board tools send nothing anywhere, and the cloud tool family is inert until you supply an operator-issued enrollment token.

board.title: FlightDeck board folder
board.description: The local board folder FlightDeck governs (contains queue/ and the event ledger). Board-scoped tools read and append here; nothing leaves this machine.

tool_set.title: Tool set
tool_set.description: Which tool family Claude sees. Valid values: 'flightdeck' (recommended - board governance only), 'conductor' (the cloud client family), 'all'. Any other value is refused at startup rather than silently expanding the surface.
